_comment: Linux (ubuntu-24.04 runner under Xvfb + openbox, release build, 60 s idle): binary 24 MB; normal open 569 MB RSS / 194 MB private (freewheel + WebKitWebProcess + WebKitNetworkProcess); closed to the tray only freewheel is left (linux_idle.rs ends the network process and trims the heap): 165 MB RSS / 24 MB private (was 240 / 48 with the network process); simulate open 857 / 317; idle CPU in the tray 0.08-0.12 % of one core (was 0.2-1.7 %); disk < 0.1 MB. RSS counts the shared GTK/WebKit libraries, so it is not comparable to Windows' working set. Budgets are those plus a margin; MB = MiB.
